test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

All work and __none play__ makes Jack a dull boy.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1' **i.e. **'No play'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence can be found in the phrase** "none play".** This phrase is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• This sentence is actually a well-known proverb that uses a specific grammatical structure, and the correct form should be** "no play".** The proverb means that without taking time off from work to relax and have fun, a person becomes bored and boring.
 
• Therefore, the **corrected sentence **would be: "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy".
 
• This sentence highlights the importance of balance in life, namely that constant working without any leisure or recreation can lead to dullness or lack of creativity.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* **"All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy".*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "None plays"** (Option 3): **The use of "plays" after "none" is grammatically incorrect in this context as this does not fit the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• "No played"** (Option 4): **"Played" is the past tense of the verb "play". In the given sentence, we need the noun form "play" to represent the idea of recreation or leisure activity, not the past tense of the verb, making this option incorrect.

​
